sources.citation: Daniel Kahneman, Amos Tversky (1979). Prospect Theory: An Analysis of Decision under Risk. Econometrica.

sources.citation: Alexander L. Brown, Taisuke Imai, Ferdinand M. Vieider, Colin F. Camerer (2024). Meta-Analysis of Empirical Estimates of Loss Aversion. Journal of Economic Literature.
sources.notes: Comprehensive meta-analysis of 607 empirical estimates confirming aggregate loss-aversion ratios near 1.8–2.0 while identifying low-stakes boundary moderators.
